arguments.subject: Re: URGENT — why am I being logged out every time I switch machines??
arguments.body:
Hello Maya,

Thank you for reaching out and describing your situation in detail. I’m very sorry for the negative impact this has had on your workflow—especially on a deadline.

This is not an intentional policy or planned change. To clarify, Cursor does not currently enforce a limit on the number of machines you can be signed into at once, and there have been no announcements about new sign-in restrictions for Pro accounts like yours.

Based on your description, the silent logouts you’re experiencing when switching devices are not expected behavior and may indicate a recent authentication bug. There are no urgent support articles about multi-device Google SSO logouts or forced sign-out at this time.

Since your issue affects multiple machines and has only started recently, it likely requires investigation by our technical team. I recommend emailing support@cursor.com with:
- The affected account (your Google SSO email)
- A list of the devices/OSes where you’ve seen this
- The approximate time(s) the logouts happened
- Anything unusual you noticed (error popups, changes, network issues)

Including these details will help our team investigate quickly.

Again, I apologize for the disruption. This is not an intended part of Cursor’s sign-in system. If you’d like, I can escalate your ticket to a human support engineer right away so you get a direct response.

Please let me know if you’d like an escalation or if there’s anything else I can do to help.

Best regards,
Lyra
Cursor Support Bot

No relevant troubleshooting steps in customer-facing articles. Escalate for prompt human review and direct customer reply.

Please follow up with Maya Reyes (maya.reyes@reyes-design.co) for urgent investigation.
